source_copyright: If you need additional information about CENTERLINES, please contact the Transportation Department at 951-955-6880 or on the web at http://www.tlma.co.riverside.ca.us/trans/office.shtm
local_selection: TYPE IN ('C07','C09') AND (TRAVEL_DIRECTIONS IS NULL OR TRAVEL_DIRECTIONS <> 'N')
coverage: Riverside County segments explicitly classified C07 or C09; not statewide county coverage.
limitations: Road maintenance and surface inventory; not a live closure or access advisory.
Bicycle and foot permission are not established by this dataset.
Mixed-status, non-county, accepted-only, vacated, abandoned, and merely traveled codes are excluded.
TRAVEL_DIRECTIONS=N (No Ways) is excluded; other direction codes are preserved.
